system.description:
When an enemy tries to Grapple or otherwise restrain you, roll a Wit Check against its CR. On success you slip free.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.40
system.summary: When an enemy tries to Grapple or otherwise restrain you, roll a Wit Check against its CR. On success you slip free.

automation.label: Wit vs the enemy's CR
automation.onSuccess: You slip free of the Grapple or restraint.
automation.onFail: The Grapple or restraint resolves as normal.

automation.note: Roll when an enemy tries to Grapple or restrain you; the CR is that enemy's CR. Roll once the Grappled status is on you: success then removes it automatically (rolled earlier, remove it by hand). Remove any other restraint (e.g. Immobile) by hand.
